look_here_first: Small annual amaranth with mostly axillary congested flower clusters rather than a big terminal spike, and relatively small ovate-to-rhombic leaves.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Amaranthaceae/Amaranthus: alternate petiolate leaves and dense clusters of tiny unisexual flowers. Habit, plant sex, hairiness, nodal spines, cluster position, bract/tepal form, and fruit dehiscence are high-value characters.

lookalikes.differences: The lack of a big terminal panicle is the fast cue. Smaller and more cluster-forming than Palmer, redroot, or green amaranth.
